name: Zombound
detailed_description:
Welcome to the End of the World

The zombie apocalypse has arrived, and humanity's last survivors are locked in a desperate struggle for resources. In ZOMBOUND, every decision matters as you navigate a hostile world where the undead aren't your only threat.

Extract or Die

Drop into infected zones to scavenge valuable loot, weapons, and supplies. But remember, you're not alone out there. Other players are hunting the same resources, and they won't hesitate to eliminate the competition. Secure your loot and extract safely, or lose everything to the wasteland.

Build Your Arsenal

Return to your safe house to craft equipment, upgrade weapons, and prepare for your next expedition. Manage your inventory carefully and customise your loadout to match your playstyle. Every piece of gear could mean the difference between life and death.

Trust No One

Form temporary alliances with other survivors or go it alone, but be cautious. In a world where resources are scarce, today's ally could be tomorrow's enemy. Engage in intense firefights while hordes of zombies are drawn to the chaos.

Key Features:

  • PVPVE Combat - Fight both players and AI zombies in dynamic encounters

  • Extraction Gameplay - Risk it all for the best loot, but make it out alive

  • Open World Exploration - Discover dangerous locations filled with valuable resources

  • Base Management - Upgrade your safe house and craft essential equipment

  • Tactical Gameplay - Balance stealth, combat, and resource management to survive

Scavenge for loot in infected zones while competing against other players and avoiding zombie hordes. Extract valuable resources to upgrade your gear, or risk losing everything. Trust no one in this unforgiving wasteland
